t: Toupret Masonry Repair Filler is a robust powder solution designed for external repairs on various rough masonry surfaces. This versatile filler is ideal for trade professionals tackling projects involving cement, concrete, breeze blocks, bricks, and stones. It fills without depth limit and repairs without the need for formwork, adhering effectively even to damp masonry. The weather-resistant formula is easy to shape and dries to a light grey colour. It can be overcoated with standard water-based masonry paint after 48 to 72 hours, ensuring a durable finish for external applications.
b: Adheres to Damp Surfaces & Weather Resistant
Fills Without Depth Limit: No Formwork Required
Easy To Shape for Smooth Repairs
